content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define variation and explain why it exists
Distinguish between genetic and environmental variation
Explain how variation is important for evolution and natural selection

refers to the differences that exist between individuals of the same species. No two individuals are exactly alike (except identical twins in some respects). This variation is the raw material for natural selection and evolution.
